beats.caption: Finnabanes, in the civil parish of Donegal and the barony of Tirhugh. Here is the story of Finnabanes and its fifteen families, from 1874 to 1926.
The parish register of Tawnawilly records one baptism at Finnabanes in 1874. Its marriage entries give no townland, so none are placed here.
Mary Anne McGinty was baptised on 5 May 1874. Michael McGinty and Brigid Martin were the parents.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 76, 61 and 60 people in Finnabanes, in 16, 17 and 14 households. Heads of household included Hammond, McCrudden and Thomas.
Here are the families of Finnabanes, from 1874 to 1926. First, the Love and McCrudden families.
